thread:
maria_cs: FYI BrightBank just escalated. After the v2.7 rollout their assistant started returning SQL snippets referencing non-existent tables and phone numbers that look plausible but are invented. Customer says this is breaking their compliance review. They pasted examples below.

sam_ml: can you drop the exact payload and model id they hit?

maria_cs: payload included chat.complete, model: redwood-2.7-optimized, prompt shortened for privacy. Customer provided this snippet:
```sql
-- customer asked: return recent transfers for acct 0xAB...
SELECT id, amount, transferred_at FROM recent_transfers_2024_extra WHERE acct_id = '0xAB' ORDER BY transferred_at DESC;
-- also returned comment: contact compliance at +1 (555) 123-9876
```

ingrid_support: ugh that phone number is totally made up. They say earlier model returned a pointer to their internal ticket id only, not fabricated contacts.

alex_eng: @sam_ml @jordan_eng any recent routing/quantization changes around the v2.7 rollout window?

deploy-bot: deploy v2.7-optimized to production completed 2312345600 by ci/cd, variant fastpath enabled for low-latency tiers.

jordan_eng: we flipped fastpath + int8-compat kernels in the rollout, also enabled new prefix-KV cache warmup by default for hosted.

sam_ml: ok can we repro locally with the same model variant + same request headers? if it's cache warmup weirdness maybe prefix substitution is leaking metadata.

maria_cs: customer attached three failing transcripts, one more example where model invents a table `customer_profiles_archive_2023_v2` and populates columns that don't exist in their schema. They said this began right after your deploy window.

alex_eng: grabbing request logs now — can you share the full transcript privately?

ingrid_support: pasted minimal repro to convo dms. Also customer notes their policy scanner flagged the phone-like strings as PII leakage but they never provided those numbers.

jordan_eng: timeline note — we swapped routing to fallback to the new quantized variant on 2312345580 when GPU load spiked. That could cause model variant mismatch in-flight.

ops-bot: autoscaler events: spike at 2312345578 -> scaled up 4 instances -> new pool used quantized variant by default.

sam_ml: two immediate actions: 1) ask CS to route traffic back to previous stable variant for that customer only (canary rollback), 2) collect exact prompts, log of model_id returned, and the raw tokens for the response.

maria_cs: doing that now. Customer asked for an SLA-level response in 2 hours. I told them we're prioritizing and will revert variant if needed. :pray:

alex_eng: if we revert, also disable prefix warmup for that tenant to see if it's related. I'll stand by to apply a per-tenant routing override.

ingrid_support: note for triage: mark this as content integrity > fabricated facts, escalate to ML infra and security. Customer is sensitive about invented contact info.

sam_ml: will start a quick repro run. If we can reproduce, plan to cut a hotfix rollback patch and a test asserting model doesn't invent plausible PII in responses for bank prompts.

maria_cs: thanks team. I'll update BrightBank after the rollback attempt.
